back: Same molecular formula, different structural formula (chain, positional or functional group).
Same molecular and structural formula, different arrangement of atoms in space (cis/trans, optical).
A C=C bond (restricted rotation because of the π bond) and two different groups on each double-bond carbon.
Cis: similar groups on the same side of the C=C. Trans: on opposite sides.

front: Effect of branching on boiling point
back: More branching → less surface contact → weaker London forces → lower boiling point.
A carbon atom bonded to four different atoms or groups.

front: Number of structural isomers of C₅H₁₂

back: Its two C–Cl dipoles point the same way and do not cancel; in the trans isomer they cancel.
